The planting fixture is a small invented dataset for application behaviour tests.
It contains nine species (one unplanted), five sites including an order scheme,
eight seasons and sixteen records totalling 370 plants: 290 resolved and 80
needing review. One record has an unknown quantity.

Names exercise macron search and match a few published map reference locations.
Identifiers, quantities and planting history are synthetic. No client workbook
or files under `docs/` are needed. Keep expected values explicit when testing
arithmetic; do not calculate the expected result using the query under test.
